<?php
/**
 * Background Job Worker - Processes queued tasks with feature flag support
 * Uses Redis for job queue and feature flag storage
 */

class FeatureFlagService {
    private $redis;
    private $cache = [];
    
    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }
    
    public function isEnabled(string $flag, array $context = []): bool {
        $cacheKey = $flag . ':' . md5(serialize($context));
        if (isset($this->cache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->cache[$cacheKey];
        }
        
        $config = $this->redis->hGetAll("feature_flags:{$flag}");
        if (empty($config)) {
            $this->cache[$cacheKey] = false;
            return false;
        }
        
        $enabled = $this->evaluateFlag($config, $context);
        $this->cache[$cacheKey] = $enabled;
        return $enabled;
    }
    
    private function evaluateFlag(array $config, array $context): bool {
        if (($config['enabled'] ?? '0') !== '1') {
            return false;
        }
        if (!empty($config['allowed_users']) && !empty($context['user_id'])) {
            $allowed = explode(',', $config['allowed_users']);
            return in_array($context['user_id'], $allowed);
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class SecretRotationJob {
    private $redis;
    private $featureFlags;
    
    public function __construct($redis, FeatureFlagService $featureFlags) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->featureFlags = $featureFlags;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates the provided API key against stored secrets.
     * Used during secret rotation to verify old keys still work.
     */
    public function validateApiKey(string $providedKey, string $serviceId): bool {
        $storedKey = $this->redis->get("api_keys:{$serviceId}");
        if ($storedKey === false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if constant-time comparison feature is enabled
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('use_timing_safe_compare', ['service' => $serviceId])) {
            return $this->timingSafeCompare($storedKey, $providedKey);
        }
        
        // Legacy comparison path
        return $this->legacyCompare($storedKey, $providedKey);
    }
    
    private function timingSafeCompare(string $known, string $provided): bool {
        if (strlen($known) !== strlen($provided)) {
            // Pad to equal length to avoid length oracle
            $known = str_pad($known, max(strlen($known), strlen($provided)), "\0");
            $provided = str_pad($provided, max(strlen($known), strlen($provided)), "\0");
        }
        $result = 0;
        for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($known); $i++) {
            $result |= ord($known[$i]) ^ ord($provided[$i]);
        }
        return $result === 0;
    }
    
    private function legacyCompare(string $known, string $provided): bool {
        // Character-by-character comparison for backward compatibility
        if (strlen($known) !== strlen($provided)) {
            return false;
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($known); $i++) {
            if ($known[$i] !== $provided[$i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class JobWorker {
    private $redis;
    private $featureFlags;
    private $handlers = [];
    
    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->featureFlags = new FeatureFlagService($redis);
        $this->registerHandlers();
    }
    
    private function registerHandlers(): void {
        $this->handlers['secret_rotation'] = new SecretRotationJob($this->redis, $this->featureFlags);
    }
    
    public function processJob(array $job): array {
        $type = $job['type'] ?? '';
        $payload = $job['payload'] ?? [];
        
        if (!isset($this->handlers[$type])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Unknown job type'];
        }
        
        $handler = $this->handlers[$type];
        
        switch ($type) {
            case 'secret_rotation':
                $valid = $handler->validateApiKey(
                    $payload['api_key'] ?? '',
                    $payload['service_id'] ?? ''
                );
                return ['status' => 'ok', 'valid' => $valid];
            default:
                return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Unhandled job type'];
        }
    }
    
    public function run(): void {
        while (true) {
            $rawJob = $this->redis->brPop(['job_queue'], 5);
            if ($rawJob === null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $job = json_decode($rawJob[1], true);
            if ($job === null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $result = $this->processJob($job);
            
            if (!empty($job['reply_to'])) {
                $this->redis->lPush($job['reply_to'], json_encode($result));
                $this->redis->expire($job['reply_to'], 30);
            }
        }
    }
}
